q1.question: What do I get out of the box?
q1.answer: A full-stack app with React 19, Hono API, self-hosted Supabase, auth, billing, file uploads, blog, docs, i18n, Kubernetes manifests, and Docker Compose for local dev.

q2.question: Can I modify or customize everything?
q2.answer: Yes. Every line is yours, generated once and kept forever. No vendor lock-in, no runtime dependency on Vibecarbon.

q3.question: What cloud providers are supported?
q3.answer: Hetzner Cloud, DigitalOcean, Linode, Vultr, and Scaleway: the same CLI, the same lifecycle, the same test coverage. Mode support varies by provider: Hetzner runs Compose, Compose HA, Kubernetes, and Kubernetes HA; DigitalOcean runs Compose, Compose HA, and Kubernetes; Linode, Vultr, and Scaleway run Compose and Compose HA. Kubernetes HA (multi-region pilot-light standby) is Hetzner-only today. The provider is a per-environment setting: pick one, and pick again whenever you want.

q4.question: How does deployment work?
q4.answer: Run "npx vibecarbon deploy" to provision a VPS, install your stack (Docker Compose or Kubernetes, depending on deploy mode), configure Traefik, deploy your app with auto-HTTPS, and set up automated backups, all in one command.

q5.question: How does pricing work?
q5.answer: Graphite is free forever: create projects, develop locally, and deploy in production on a single server, with every add-on included. Fullerene ($149, one-time) unlocks advanced deploy modes (Compose HA, Kubernetes, and Kubernetes HA) plus GitOps CI/CD, for your own products. Agency is a contact-us license for deploying on behalf of clients, white-labeling, or reselling Vibecarbon-powered services. Fullerene is a one-time payment with no subscriptions; Agency pricing is set by agreement. Either way, your infrastructure.

q6.question: How many projects can I create with one license?
q6.answer: Unlimited. One Fullerene license covers every project you create; there's no per-project fee. The license is tied to you or your organization.

q7.question: Do I need a paid license to charge users or run a SaaS?
q7.answer: No. Single-server Docker Compose production deploys are free on Graphite, including your own commercial SaaS. You need Fullerene only for advanced deploy modes: Compose HA, Kubernetes, or Kubernetes HA. Deploying for someone else (a client, an employer, a white-label product) is Agency, a contact-us license for client and enterprise deployments. The test: is this your product? Fullerene. Someone else's? Agency.

q8.question: What happens if Vibecarbon shuts down?
q8.answer: Nothing changes for your app. The generated code is MIT-licensed with zero runtime dependency on Vibecarbon; it's just a codebase you own outright. The CLI is Fair Source (FSL), so you can run it from source indefinitely for any non-competing use, and every release converts to the MIT license two years after publication. Your infrastructure runs in your own cloud account.

q9.question: Do I need DevOps experience to deploy?
q9.answer: No. The CLI handles provisioning, SSL, scaling, backups, and monitoring. You need an account with a supported provider, a domain, and SMTP credentials for email. That's it. All the Kubernetes manifests and Docker Compose files live in your project if you want to understand or customize what's being set up.
